mentions.name: PlateMath
mentions.description: PlateMath is a power-user workout tracker that logs all PRs and lifting metrics, with fast keypad input or CodeMirror-style syntax input for jotting sets. It generates any exercise from a movement + modifier system, tracks fractional sets and bodypart volume, and computes rolling averages and other metrics. Users can build and import training programs using a syntax language.
mentions.source_excerpt: TLDR power user work out tracker, all PRs, metrics, fast keypad input or codemirror syntax input if you're lazy type that jots in notepad. Generate any exercise based on movement + modifer system. Mountan of metrics (your basic lifitng stuff), rolling averages etc. Fractional set tracking, bodypart volume... too much to list. Build and import programs using syntax.
